To build a robust sports ecosystem, district-level potential will be identified to foster specialized training environments. A key focus was placed on preparing athletes for the 2036 Olympics through a comprehensive talent hunt campaign targeting children aged five to fifteen, ensuring early identification based on physical fitness and interest. The government reaffirmed its commitment to establishing a modern twenty-first-century sports framework, featuring specialized universities, modern training centers, sports science, and international collaboration in coaching. Furthermore, the youth dialogue platform will integrate ideas, governance suggestions, and aspirations into national sports policy process. The program underscored the vital role of sportsperson spirit in instilling resilience, discipline, and healthy competition required for building a stronger nation.

2036 Olympics Prep, Talent Hunt For Ages 5-15 & Building Modern Sports Ecosystem FocusAt the Khelo India Dialogue, a vision for building a modern 21st-century sports ecosystem was outlined, placing special focus on preparing athletes for the 2036 Olympics. A talent hunt campaign targeting children aged 5 to 15 will identify and train young prospects based on fitness and interest. India seeks to tap into its coastline and mountain regions to excel in water, winter, and emerging sports such as surfing and sports climbing. The initiative emphasizes developing district-level sports ecosystems, sports universities, modern training facilities, and international collaboration in sports science and coaching. The platform integrates youth ideas on governance and sports development into the policy process. Sports are highlighted for instilling sportsmanship, resilience, and discipline, with para athletes serving as nationwide inspirations. Beyond competition, sports promote a healthy quality of life, lifestyle changes, and act as an effective deterrent against substance abuse among the youth.
